Rome.tagline: Historic core and the usual first Italian base
Rome.general: Start here: the Forum and Colosseum, a neighbourhood evening, and one big indoor morning.
tips: Book Vatican timed entry
August many Romans leave town

Naples.general: Vibrant bay city between Rome and Bari — pizza birthplace, historic centro, and a natural break on the Frecciarossa / Adriatic rail corridor.
activities: Pizza al portafoglio in the old quarter
tips: Most Rome–Bari trains call at Napoli Centrale — book a through ticket or same-day connection
Keep bags light if transferring between platforms
Naples.itinerary: Day 2 — optional lunch or short stroll if your Rome→Bari routing includes a Naples connection.
Naples.tagline: Rail hub on the Rome–Bari corridor

Bari.general: Port city gateway to the Adriatic — old town lanes, seafood, and the ferry south to Montenegro.
tips: Park near the waterfront for an early ferry
Try orecchiette in the old quarter
Bari.itinerary: Days 2–3 — arrive by train from Rome (via Naples), then ferry hub before the coast road south.

Bar.general: Southern Montenegro base with Ottoman old town, beaches, and quick access to Lake Skadar.
tips: Haj Nehaj fortress is a short drive uphill
Summer traffic peaks on coastal roads
Bar.itinerary: Day 4 — first Montenegro stop after the ferry; ideal for fortress and coast pairing.

Budva Old Town.general: Walled resort town mixing beach life with medieval lanes and nightlife along the riviera.
tips: Visit ramparts before midday heat
Parking fills fast in peak season
Budva Old Town.itinerary: Coastal evening stop between Bar and Kotor on the classic northbound arc.

tips: Evening light is best on the walls
Link with Kotor for a two-bay day
Old Town of Budva.itinerary: Heritage arc stop — pair with Haj Nehaj fortress the same day.

Kotor.general: Fjord-like bay setting with medieval walls climbing the hillside — ideal for a moderate viewpoint hike.
tips: Start fortress climb early to avoid cruise crowds
Bring layers for ridge wind
Kotor.itinerary: Days 4–5 — use Kotor as the hiking hub before continuing up the coast.

Herceg Novi.general: Garden town at the bay entrance — fortresses, stair streets, and boat links toward the Blue Cave.
tips: Boats to Blue Cave run seasonally — confirm morning departures
Steep lanes — wear grippy shoes
Herceg Novi.itinerary: Day 6 — launch point for cave and Dubrovnik transfer days.

Haj Nehaj Fortress.general: Hilltop Venetian fortress overlooking Bar and the coast — short, steep climb with wide views.
tips: No shade on walls — bring water
Sunset timing is spectacular
Haj Nehaj Fortress.itinerary: Heritage arc morning block from Bar base.

Kanli kula.general: Red fortress above Herceg Novi — concerts in summer and sweeping bay views.
tips: Check event schedule for evening visits
Combine with Blue Cave same day
Kanli kula.itinerary: Heritage arc — afternoon fortress before coastal drive north.

tips: Midday sun gives the blue glow
Book small-group boats from Herceg Novi

Dubrovnik.general: Walled old town on the Adriatic with dramatic sea cliffs and dense heritage lanes.
tips: Buy walls ticket online in summer
Take first ferry to Lokrum for quiet trails
Dubrovnik.itinerary: Day 7 — plan the walls early, then a relaxed harbour loop at golden hour.

photos.caption: Dubrovnik old town from the walls

Mostar.general: Ottoman bridge town in a river gorge — iconic Stari Most and bazaar copper craft lanes.
tips: Respect divers — viewing from café terraces is fine
Try ćevapi near the river
Mostar.itinerary: Inland heritage detour between coast legs — allow half day minimum.

Badanj Cave.general: Archaeological cave site near Stolac — Paleolithic art and quiet Herzegovina landscape.
tips: Confirm opening hours locally
Pair with Mostar overnight
Badanj Cave.itinerary: Heritage arc extension — short stop en route to the coast.

Split.general: Coastal city anchored by Diocletian's Palace and a strong ferry/hiking gateway to Biokovo.
tips: Enter palace from waterfront gates early
Ferry desks cluster near the port
Split.itinerary: Day 9 — combine urban heritage morning with an afternoon ridge option.

Mljet National Park.general: Forested island park with saltwater lakes, monastery islet, and calm cycling paths.
tips: Stay in Pomena for park access
Last ferries from Dubrovnik are seasonal
Mljet National Park.itinerary: Island module — ferry from Dubrovnik, overnight recommended.

Krka National Park.general: Tiered waterfalls you can swim near — boardwalks through forested gorges upstream of Sibenik.
tips: Arrive at opening for fewer tour buses
Combine with Split or Zadar drive
Krka National Park.itinerary: Full-day park block between Split and Paklenica.

photos.caption: Skradinski buk waterfalls, Krka — Krka National Park

Paklenica National Park.general: Limestone canyon under Velebit — classic big-wall hiking and shaded river walks.
tips: Start canyon trail before noon heat
Bring 2L water for ridge variants
Paklenica National Park.itinerary: Major hiking day — longest vertical gain on Adriatic routes.

tips: Route C balances lakes and distance
No swimming — stay on boardwalks
Plitvice Lakes National Park.itinerary: Day 12 — longest hiking block; start early and carry rain layer.

Plitvice.general: Shorthand for the lakes park — cascading turquoise pools linked by wooden walkways.
tips: Ticket windows queue after 10:00 — pre-book online
October colours are exceptional
Plitvice.itinerary: Capstone nature day before pushing to Rijeka or Trieste.

Rijeka.general: Port city under the Učka massif — Austro architecture, trsat castle, and ferry links north.
tips: Good base between Plitvice and Istria
Parking garages near centre
Rijeka.itinerary: Transit night with optional castle walk.

Pula.general: Istrian Roman arena town — amphitheatre, vineyards, and short drives to hill villages.
tips: Arena lighting is best at dusk
Try truffles and malvazija wine nearby
Pula.itinerary: Istria cultural stop before Trieste or Italy border.

Trieste.general: Habsburg port where Italy meets Slovenia — coffee houses, castle hill, and seafront miramare nearby.
tips: Bora wind can be fierce — check forecast
End-of-route customs if driving onward
Trieste.itinerary: Final Adriatic city on the classic northbound spine.

Tbilisi.general: Layered capital with sulfur baths, wine bars, and a dramatic old town above the Mtkvari.
tips: Try amber wine in Vino underground
Marshrutkas to Kazbegi leave early
Tbilisi.itinerary: Days 1–2 — stock supplies before mountain legs.

Weather changes fast — pack shell
Gergeti Trinity Church.itinerary: Day 3 flagship hike — start at dawn if possible.

Day trips to Geghard and Garni fit here
Yerevan.itinerary: Days 5–6 — base for Armenian heritage loop.

Modest dress inside chapels
Geghard.itinerary: Day 6 — half-day with Garni canyon temple.

Bellegarde Fort.itinerary: Day 1 — route opener on the Iberia arc.

Granada.general: Alhambra palace city beneath Sierra Nevada — Moorish gardens and Albaicín miradors.
tips: Alhambra tickets sell out weeks ahead
Wear comfortable shoes for cobbles
Granada.itinerary: Days 7–8 — anchor heritage block before Gibraltar.

Rock of Gibraltar.general: Limestone monolith with Barbary macaques, WWII tunnels, and views across two continents.
tips: Take cable car up, walk down if fit
Close bags — macaques are bold

Tokyo.tagline: Neighbourhoods, rail, and the usual first Japan base
Tokyo.general: Asakusa and Shibuya, a food street, and an optional Hakone day before the Shinkansen west.
activities: Tsukiji outer or a neighbourhood ramen crawl
tips: Suica/Pasmo on your phone
Hakone is the common extra night

Tokyo Return.general: Final night in the capital — last-minute shopping, airport trains, and favourite district revisit.
tips: Narita vs Haneda — confirm airport early
Pack omiyage gifts last day
Tokyo Return.itinerary: Day 9 — transit buffer before international flight.

Kenroku-en.general: One of Japan's three great gardens — ponds, bridges, and seasonal maples in Kanazawa.
tips: Pair with Kanazawa Old District same day
Early entry avoids tour groups
Kenroku-en.itinerary: Day 3 — refined garden block on the north coast leg.

Kanazawa Old District.general: Preserved samurai and geisha quarters — gold leaf crafts and Edo-era streetscapes.
tips: Stay near Kenroku-en for walking
Try gold-leaf ice cream once
Kanazawa Old District.itinerary: Day 3 overnight — cultural counterpoint to Tokyo.

Osaka.general: Short hop from Kyoto. Street food, a castle park, and Nara if you have a spare day.
tips: KIX is the usual departure
Eat early or late to skip the worst queues

Sydney.tagline: Harbour ferries, coastal walks, and an easy first base
Sydney.general: Most Australia trips start here: Circular Quay, a ferry, a beach walk, and a day inland to the Blue Mountains.
activities: The Rocks and Opera House precinct
tips: Opal or contactless for trains and ferries
Swim between the flags
Sydney.itinerary: Days 1–3 — keep the first days walkable around the harbour.

Katoomba.tagline: Three Sisters and Jamison Valley lookouts
Katoomba.general: The usual Blue Mountains overnight from Sydney — cliff walks, Scenic World if you want the railway, and cool evenings.
activities: Scenic World or a waterfall track
tips: Train from Central is simpler than driving on weekends
Weather turns quickly on the escarpment

Canberra.tagline: Planned capital between Sydney and Melbourne
Canberra.general: A practical overnight on the inland drive: galleries, Parliament, and a lake circuit.
tips: A car helps between precincts
Monday some museums close

Melbourne.tagline: Laneways, trams, and the jump-off for the Great Ocean Road
Melbourne.general: Coffee, galleries, and a tram-shaped city before you point west along the coast.
activities: Day on the peninsula or in the Yarra Valley
tips: Myki for trams
Book Great Ocean Road tours if not self-driving
Melbourne.itinerary: Days 8–10 — city days before the coast.

Torquay.tagline: Start of the Great Ocean Road
Torquay.general: Surf town where the Great Ocean Road begins; use it as a base for Lorne and the Twelve Apostles.
activities: Drive toward Lorne and Apollo Bay
tips: Leave Melbourne early to beat traffic
Apostles car parks fill by late morning

Christchurch.tagline: Garden-city start for a South Island drive
Christchurch.general: Collect a car, walk the rebuild precincts and gardens, then head inland.
tips: One-way camper drop in Queenstown is common
Nor'west winds can be strong

Queenstown.general: The South Island hub: lake, gondola, and day trips to vineyards or Glenorchy.
activities: Glenorchy or a jet-boat if you want it
tips: Beds book out in summer
This Queenstown is the NZ one, not Tasmania

Te Anau.general: Quiet lake town used as the base for Milford or Doubtful Sound.
tips: Milford road can close for weather or ice
Book cruises ahead in January

Wanaka.general: The usual calmer last stop: lake swims, a lookout walk, then back to a flight.
activities: Roy's Peak or a shorter ridge
tips: Roy's Peak starts before dawn in season
Fuel up before remote legs

Nadi.general: Almost every Fiji trip lands here. Use it for the temple, Denarau boats, and a first reef day.
tips: Cover shoulders at the temple
Airport days are busy — book transfers

Pacific Harbour.general: The adventure strip on the Coral Coast — shark dives, river trips, and a slower night than Nadi.
tips: Book shark dives ahead
Afternoons often bring showers

Suva.tagline: Harbour capital of markets and rainforest parks
Suva.general: Fiji's political city: museum, market, and an easy forest walk at Colo-i-Suva.
tips: Weekday traffic around Victoria Parade
Carry cash for the market

Florence.tagline: Duomo, galleries, and a Tuscan day
Florence.general: The middle of the classic rail triangle — dense, walkable, and an easy jump to Chianti or Pisa.
tips: Uffizi slots sell out
The centro is compact — skip the car

Venice.tagline: Vaporetti and quieter sestieri after the mainland
Venice.general: Finish on the water. Walk early, ride a vaporetto, and leave San Marco for off-peak hours.
tips: A 48-hour vaporetto pass usually beats single tickets
Acqua alta season is autumn–winter

Edinburgh.tagline: Castle ridge and the usual Scottish start
Edinburgh.general: Old Town, New Town, and a hill walk before you head north.
tips: Festival month (August) needs rooms booked early
Weather does four seasons in a day

Inverness.tagline: Highland railhead and Loch Ness base
Inverness.general: The practical Highlands hub: loch, battlefield, and the jump toward Skye.
tips: The sleeper or daytime rail from Edinburgh is the usual arrival
Midges in still summer evenings

Portree.general: The usual Skye overnight: coloured harbour, and a Storr or Quiraing morning.
tips: Single-track roads and summer coaches
Fuel and dinners book out in July

Glasgow.tagline: West-coast city and the usual departure airport
Glasgow.general: One night for music, the West End, and a morning flight.
tips: Airport is west of the city — allow transfer time

Barcelona.tagline: Gaudí, beach, and the Mediterranean start
Barcelona.general: Most first Spain trips begin here: Gothic streets, one big Gaudí visit, and a swim.
tips: Book Sagrada Família
Pickpockets on the metro and Ramblas

Seville.general: The usual Andalusian finish — orange trees, a big cathedral, and heat in summer.
tips: Alcázar tickets online
August afternoons are for shade

Kyoto.tagline: Temples and the classic middle of the Golden Route
Kyoto.general: Fushimi Inari at opening, Gion after dark, and one bamboo or gold-pavilion morning.
tips: Temple mornings beat buses
Gion has photography rules on some lanes

Bangkok.tagline: River, palaces, and the usual first Thailand week
Bangkok.general: River boats, one palace morning, Chinatown or a cooking class, then fly north.
tips: Cover knees and shoulders at palaces
BTS and river boats beat taxis in traffic

Chiang Mai.tagline: Old-city temples and cooler northern evenings
Chiang Mai.general: Walled old city, a mountain temple, and a walking-street night.
tips: Songthaews are the local hop
Burning-season haze is worst Feb–Apr
